note: Jefferson County OR tax lots appear only in the ODF statewide TaxlotsDisplay MapServer layer 15 (polygons; fields MAPTAXLOT, OWNERLINE1, PRPCLASS). That layer advertises capability 'Map' only: every query (JSON, GeoJSON) returns 'Requested operation is not supported by this service', so features cannot be read. No county-hosted FeatureServer/MapServer or downloadable parcel file was found. The county GIS mapper (maps.co.jefferson.or.us) is not an ArcGIS REST service and was unreachable; the county GIS page offers data only via a fee schedule.
